boundaries.name: India State Boundary GeoJSON
boundaries.provider: National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India
boundaries.citation: National Water Informatics Centre. (2025). State Boundary [Geospatial dataset]. National Water Data Portal, Government of India.
boundaries.coverage: All 36 Indian States and Union Territories
limitations: Official Survey of India boundaries; topological simplification at 0.01 deg used for web display.
entities: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu

rainfall.name: IMD State-Wise Daily Rainfall
rainfall.citation: India Meteorological Department. (n.d.). Rainfall Daily IMD - StateWise Daily Rainfall [CSV dataset]. National Water Data Portal, Government of India.
rainfall.coverage: 36 Indian States/UTs + Regional summaries + Country aggregate
limitations: Dataset represents snapshot daily observations from NWIC portal, not unbroken multi-decade daily time series.
Missing rainfall actuals are retained as null/NaN; never imputed as 0.0 mm.

temperature.name: Historical Regional Maximum Temperature
temperature.provider: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM Pune) / IMD
temperature.citation: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology. (2012). IITM Indian Regional Monthly Surface Air Temperature Dataset: All-India and Regional Maximum Temperatures (1901-2007) [TXT dataset]. IITM Pune.
limitations: Monthly mean maximum temperatures are regional climate indicators, NOT daily heatwave event records.
Do NOT present monthly maximums as daily heatwave declarations.

drought.name: India Drought Area Time Series
drought.provider: Water and Climate Lab, IIT Gandhinagar (India Drought Monitor)
drought.citation: Water and Climate Lab, IIT Gandhinagar. (n.d.). India Drought Monitor - National Drought Area Time Series [TXT dataset]. Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar.
limitations: Strictly national-level drought percentages; does NOT provide state-level or district-level drought data.
Do NOT manufacture state-level drought observations from this national series.

flood.name: India Flood Inventory-Impacts (IFI-Impacts)
flood.provider: HydroSense Lab, Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (Saharia et al.)
flood.citation: Saharia, M. (2025). India Flood Inventory-Impacts (IFI-Impacts), 1967-2023, Version 4 [Dataset]. Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.16994648
flood.coverage: India flood events across states and districts
limitations: Historical event inventory with casualty and impact data from official reports and media records.
Blank impact/casualty fields are retained as null; zero casualties or damage are never imputed.
Recorded historical events do not represent exhaustive future flood risk.

landslide.name: India Landslide Dataset
landslide.citation: riseuppant. (n.d.). India Landslide Dataset [CSV dataset]. GitHub repository Disaster_Management.
limitations: Community-hosted dataset; original scientific provenance is unverified.
Magnitude scale is uncalibrated and undocumented; used for spatial frequency and density only.

cyclone.name: IBTrACS North Indian Ocean Cyclone Tracks
cyclone.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
cyclone.citation: Gahtan, J., Knapp, K. R., Schreck, C. J., Diamond, H. J., Kossin, J. P., & Kruk, M. C. (2024). International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS), Version 4r01 [Dataset]. NOAA NCEI.
cyclone.coverage: North Indian Ocean (Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea)
cyclone.units: wind in kts and km/h, pressure in hPa/mb, coordinates in WGS84
limitations: Covers entire North Indian Ocean basin; not every storm tracked made landfall in India.
Track intersections with coastlines do not constitute confirmed official landfall without meteorological verification.
